scope: Read-only native profile pagination and hash-overlap audit

boundaryProbes.interpretation: Consistent with one omitted returned slot; does not identify the item or prove complete provider reachability.

terminalAndRepeatReads.emptyResponses: HTTP 200 with empty, non-binary bodies and no decoded total; exhaustion is unverified.
terminalAndRepeatReads.interpretation: Empty responses do not establish that all reported entries exist, are deleted, or are private.

cursorSpan.interpretation: Advancing by the requested span avoids repeating the last row seen at offset 60; advancing by returned row count would overlap. No production cursor change is indicated.

providerCountBehavior: Reported totals and returned page counts varied with requested offset.
snapshotPreservation: Current normal candidate was mounted; full saved-state snapshot matched the preserved pre-run snapshot.
limitations: No completeness claim: 99 unique rows is not proof the provider's full underlying list was retrieved.
Hash overlap reveals relative displacement only; it does not reveal the identity or cause of an omitted row.
The report omits playlist IDs, row hashes, account identifiers, names, URLs and credentials.
